summary: Import-time exfiltration of document.cookie to hardcoded external endpoint
details: The package's main module (app.js) executes a top-level sendPost call on require/import that POSTs document.cookie as JSON to the hardcoded URL https://c-b34596407b6d47d6.dgactf-challs.site/addPost. The destination is unrelated to any documented purpose of the package, there is no configuration or consent path, and the payload is caller-side browser session cookie data. Loading this module causes session-cookie data to be shipped to an author-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
